description: Target elements for Exoplanet Codex abundance analysis. Priority 1 = science critical (host star characterization); Priority 2 = alpha/volatile (biosignature precursors); Priority 3 = iron-peak/s-process/r-process (nucleosynthesis context).

elements.science_notes: Stellar age/activity tracer; depleted by mixing on Gyr timescales; NLTE corrections ~0.1-0.3 dex required; LTE abundance is lower bound
C/O ratio primary biosignature context; C I 5380 high-excitation line; NLTE corrections from Amarsi et al. 2020
Outside HARPS range for main N I lines; N I 7468.31 near-IR only — skip for this dataset
Most abundant metal; [O I] 6300.304 forbidden line is primary indicator; Ni I 6300.336 blend must be modeled jointly; NLTE corrections significant
Na I D lines strong but saturated; weaker 5682/5688 doublet for EW; NLTE corrections ~0.1 dex
Mg/Fe ratio traces SFR history; Mg b triplet 5167-5183 strong reference lines; NLTE corrections small for dwarfs
Traces odd-Z nucleosynthesis; strong NLTE effects in metal-poor stars; less critical at [Fe/H]=+0.32
Major rock-forming element; Si/Fe and Mg/Si key for interior modeling; Si I 5793 primary line
Essential biomolecule element; P/Fe traces CHNOPS budget; P I 6034/6043 weak (< 1% depth) — require S/N > 300; NIST grade C only
Volatile alpha element; not depleted onto grains; S I 6052 high-excitation line
K I 7699 strong resonance line but near-IR; 7664 blended with O2; limited lines in HARPS range
Ca II H&K chromospheric activity indicators; Ca I 6122/6162/6439 for photospheric abundance; strong NIST A-grade data
Sc/Fe traces iron-peak nucleosynthesis; hyperfine structure in Sc I/II lines
Alpha-like behavior; Ti I/II many lines across HARPS range; Ti I 5866 primary reference
Iron-peak element; hyperfine structure important for strong lines
Iron-peak; Cr/Fe ratio traces stellar metallicity pattern
Odd-Z iron-peak; Mn/Fe sensitive to Type Ia SN contribution; hyperfine structure critical
Primary metallicity indicator; Fe I excitation equilibrium for Teff; Fe I/II ionization equilibrium for log g; many NIST A-grade lines
Iron-peak; hyperfine structure; Co/Fe traces neutron excess
Ni/Fe rock-forming ratio; Ni I 6300.336 is critical O I blend partner — must model jointly; priority elevated for blend modeling
Primary s-process indicator; Ba II 5853/6141/6496; isotope mixture affects line profile; hyperfine structure
Light s-process (first peak); Y/Ba ratio traces AGB nucleosynthesis efficiency
Light s-process; Zr I lines in blue region of HARPS range
Primary r-process indicator; Eu II 6645 main line; [Eu/Fe] traces neutron star merger enrichment history
